name: exp03_h4_baselines
title: Classical regression of the H₄ curve from the same spacings
description: Gaussian process and MLP fitted to exact FCI energies at the same 3, 5 or 9 spacings as the conditional QNN, tested on 0.4-3.0 Å. The QNN needs no labels; these models do. Research question 3.

config.labels: FCI energies at the training spacings

targets.E-HF: correlation energy E_FCI(d) - E_HF(d) (delta learning); HF is computed at every test spacing and added back

config.gp: ConstantKernel * RBF, length scale bounds 0.05-10 A, normalize_y, 5 restarts, alpha 1e-10
config.mlp: 2 x 32 tanh, lbfgs, max_iter 5000, alpha 1e-4, inputs to [-1, 1], targets standardised
